body.estimand_functional: \(\theta\in[L(o,e),U(o,e)]\), with \(L=\max\{0,\sum_j a_j-k+1,\max_i(b_i-\sum_{j\neq i}h_j)\}\) and \(U=\min\{g,\min_j a_j,\min_{|S|\geq2}\sum_{j\in S}c_j/(|S|-1)\}\)

sampling_model.design: One observational block and one block for each single-treatment intervention; each block is multinomial on its stated finite alphabet.
sampling_model.units: The observational block has \(n_0\) independent common-population units and intervention block \(j\) has \(n_j\) independent common-population units; cross-block independence is not required for the union-bound coverage statement.
sampling_model.treatment: The observational treatment is factual, while block \(j\) records outcomes under the intervention \(X\leftarrow j\).
sampling_model.overlap: No positive-cell condition is imposed; zero observational and intervention cells are allowed.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: No nuisance functions are estimated; empirical multinomial cell frequencies enter the confidence polytope.

body.tldr: Common-population observational and single-treatment intervention margins determine the exact identified interval for every finite-alphabet scalar conjunction probability of causation.  The Shu--Wang--Li endpoints are attained for every compatible real input by indicator coarsening, upper intersection packing, and a deleted-diagonal lower flow with a residual-failure invariant.  For rational inputs, sorting evaluates the endpoints and explicit laws of support at most \(N_\star\) preserve the relevant input denominator grid.  A separate exact margin-kernel step preserves the active-affine or minimum-cut certificate while constructively compressing either endpoint law to at most \(2mr-m\) atoms of polynomial encoding length; no denominator-divisibility claim is made after compression.  Thus \(mr\leq s_\star(m,r,k)\leq2mr-m\), and block-multinomial confidence-region inversion supplies uniform finite-sample coverage while Cheng--Mao--Pearl--Li retain credit for directional inference.

project_justification.gap: Shu--Wang--Li prove the scalar formulas but leave all-dimensional pointwise tightness open; Xie--Li's constructive proof is binary; and generic response-signature programs hide the scalar geometry in exponentially many columns while supplying neither the sorted endpoint evaluator nor a certificate-preserving linear-support construction.
project_justification.niche: The common-population scalar conjunction problem has two complementary finite structures: factual failures delete diagonal flow edges, and every endpoint-optimal response law is flat along any feasible kernel direction of the \(2mr-m\) retained margin rows.
project_justification.fill: The paper derives exact categorical lifting, packing and flow endpoint laws, sorted and min-cut dual certificates, grid-preserving polynomial witnesses of support at most \(N_\star\), constructive certificate-preserving compression to at most \(2mr-m\) atoms, a matching \(mr\) support lower family, and boundary-safe finite-sample inversion.

body.related_work: Shu--Wang--Li Theorem 2 supplies the scalar affine formulas and leaves their general-dimensional tightness unresolved.  Xie--Li Theorem 3.2 is the closest constructive precedent, solving the binary eight-cell system.  Koperberg Proposition 6 supplies a finite Hall--Strassen coupling principle adapted to the deleted-diagonal lower network.  Tian--Pearl supplies the binary PNS interval used only as an algebraic sanity check, and Li--Pearl gives earlier recursive multivalued bounds.  Rossetto--Antonucci provides a generic sharp response-signature linear program and SCM realization; the present scalar geometry instead yields sorted endpoint evaluation, explicit active-affine or minimum-cut certificates, grid-preserving witnesses, and constructive certificate-preserving \(O(mr)\)-support compression.  Cheng--Mao--Pearl--Li provides active-set directional limit theory and is credited rather than relabeled.  Horowitz--Lee, Stoye, and Kaido--Molinari--Stoye motivate confidence-region and projection inference, while the finite-sample result here is specialized to the block-multinomial margin polytope.  Harinen and coauthors provide the hypothetical common-population customer-journey setting in which a prespecified multichannel response-pattern probability is a concrete scalar consumer.
body.technical_internal_limitation: Scalar sharpness does not imply simultaneous sharpness for several response patterns, so separately summing scalar endpoint values can yield an unattainable policy utility.  The confidence interval is a conservative outer inversion and has no optimal-width claim.  The endpoint-support frontier satisfies \(mr\leq s_\star(m,r,k)\leq2mr-m\), hence has exact order \(mr\), but the exact worst-case constant remains open.  Divisibility by \(D\) or \(D(\ell-1)\) belongs only to the original grid-preserving witnesses of support at most \(N_\star\); the compressed witnesses have polynomial-bit rational weights with no asserted denominator divisor.
body.honest_scope: The finite max-flow/min-cut theorem, multinomial concentration, and exact rational linear algebra are standard inputs.  The proved contribution is all-alphabet categorical lifting, upper and lower endpoint attainment, the residual-failure invariant, exact interval equality, the grid and bit audit, and constructive certificate-preserving compression.  Unequal alphabets and repeated queried labels are covered, but factual-conditioned representative probabilities of causation, incomplete subpopulations, mediator restrictions, population mismatch, and simultaneous vectors of conjunctions are outside the theorem.  The Tian--Pearl binary reduction is an unnumbered sanity corollary, not a research-target theorem.  For \(k=1\), the target is the known margin \(a_1\); for \(r=1\), the identified interval is \([1,1]\).  The support frontier has proved order \(mr\), with lower bound \(mr\) and constructive upper bound \(2mr-m\); only the exact constant remains unresolved.  The larger \(N_\star\) support guarantee is retained solely for its stronger denominator-grid property.
